note: SYNTHETIC fixture — hand-built by generate.mjs, never touched any chain. It describes a v4 spend that proves against the newest root the tree had, so P12 measures age 0 and passes. It is the positive half of the root-age control pair — without it, a P12 that failed every spend would satisfy verify/fixtures/v4-stale-root and measure nothing. The two fixtures are one world and differ in one field, the 32 bytes of merkle_root. It is NOT evidence that any real spend names a fresh root: the client that sends the stored path is what decides that, and it was MEASURED naming a 4-insertion-old root on devnet 2026-09-15.
